capabilities: Draft slides as one continuous note with numbered dividers, layout text areas, and presenter notes
Reorder, copy, cut, paste, and delete slides in a drag-and-drop outline sidebar
Insert new slides from a layout picker with number-key shortcuts
Preview up to five of a slide's images beside the draft
Open the presentation in the MarkdownPoint desktop app via command
disambiguation: Not a standalone presentation tool: the plugin only writes, organizes, and stores slides, while design, 3D, animation, and presenting happen in the separate MarkdownPoint desktop app.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13 or newer; the desktop app is downloaded from markdownpoint.com. The plugin sets no default hotkeys. Includes a troubleshooting FAQ covering format-version limits, conflicted .mdpoint files, and save failures with local recovery copies. Interface localized in 21 languages with right-to-left support for Arabic and Persian.
problem: Obsidian has no way to author a slide deck as a single continuous draft with per-slide text areas, presenter notes, and a drag-and-drop slide outline.

relations.evidence: Run MarkdownPoint: Open in MarkdownPoint to save the presentation and open it in the desktop app.
If you use Notebook Navigator, keep the outline on the right.

summary: Writing half of a presentation suite: draft slides as one continuous Markdown note with a drag-and-drop outline, paired with the MarkdownPoint desktop app.
